name: acqagent
description: Open-source Claude skills for federal acquisition — FAR research, clause checks, and compliance groundwork.

plugins.name: far-clause-checker
plugins.description: Validates a user's clause list against the acquisition.gov Smart Matrix (FAR 52.2xx) and the JUL 2026 HHSAR Deviations matrix (HHSAR 352.2xx) during the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO), and produces a standalone .docx compliance report. FAR and HHSAR only; no DFARS.
